text: Most people think household resilience means buying more stuff. It usually means removing single points of failure: one payment method, one charger, one food plan, one backup. I made a free 30-point check across six everyday systems.

A useful preparedness question is not “Do I own emergency gear?” It is “Could normal life keep working for 72 hours if one system stopped?” Food, water, power, money, home routines and backups all matter.

Small recurring leaks are easy to ignore because none of them feels serious alone: unused subscriptions, food waste, replacement purchases, fees. Annualize them and the picture changes. Check the Money section in this free diagnostic.
30-Point Household Resilience Checklist — score food, water & power, money, home systems, free time and backups in about 3 minutes.
